title: Бытие 1 — Genesis 1
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.explain: Свет is the subject — the thing that appeared — so it takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.translation: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
cases.explain: Земля is the direct object of сотворил (created) → accusative. For feminine -я nouns the accusative ending is -ю.

cases.translation: God's Spirit was hovering over the waters.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) always takes the instrumental. Водами is the instrumental plural.

cases.sentence: Бог назвал свет днём, а ___ ночью.
cases.translation: God called the light “day”, and the darkness “night”.
cases.explain: Тьма is what God named — the direct object of назвал → accusative (тьму).
With назвать X Y (“to call X a Y”), the name Y goes in the instrumental: небом.

cases.translation: God separated the water from the water.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → воды.

cases.translation: Let there be an expanse between the waters.
cases.explain: Между (between) takes the instrumental → водами (instrumental plural).

cases.translation: Let the waters be gathered together under the heaven.
cases.explain: Под (under) with a location takes the instrumental → небом.
The name in назвать X Y goes in the instrumental → землёй. (Compare question 2, where земля was the direct object and took землю.)

cases.translation: Let there be lights in the vault of the sky.
cases.explain: На meaning “on/at” a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → своде.
Here на marks direction (light moving onto the earth), so it takes the accusative → землю. Compare question 10: на + location took the prepositional.

cases.translation: God created man in his own image.
cases.explain: The preposition по in this sense (“according to / after”) takes the dative → образу.

reading.ru: Земля была пуста и безлика, тьма была над бездной, и Дух Божий парил над водами.
reading.question: What was the earth like before God began shaping it?
reading.explain: “The earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.”

reading.ru: Бог сказал: «Да будет свет», и появился свет.
reading.question: What did God create on the first day by speaking?
reading.explain: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light — the work of the first day.

reading.ru: Бог назвал свет днём, а тьму ночью.
reading.question: What did God name the light and the darkness?
reading.explain: “God called the light ‘day’, and the darkness he called ‘night’.”

reading.question: What did God call the expanse He made on the second day?
reading.explain: God made the expanse to separate the waters and called it “heaven” (the sky).

reading.ru: И сказал Бог: да соберутся вместе воды под небом, и да появится суша, и стало так.
reading.question: On the third day, what appeared once the waters were gathered together?
reading.explain: The waters gathered into one place so that dry land could appear; God called the dry land “earth”.

reading.ru: Бог назвал сушу землёй, а собранные воды назвал морями.
reading.question: What did God call the gathered waters?
reading.explain: “God called the dry land ‘earth’, and the gathered waters he called ‘seas’.”

reading.ru: И Бог сказал: да будут светила на небесном своде, чтобы отделять день от ночи, и пусть они служат знаками, чтобы различать времена, дни и годы.
reading.question: What was the purpose of the lights God made on the fourth day?
options: To separate day from night and mark seasons, days, and years
reading.correct: To separate day from night and mark seasons, days, and years
reading.explain: The lights were set in the sky to divide day from night and to serve as signs for seasons, days, and years.

reading.ru: Бог создал два великих светила: большое светило, чтобы управлять днём, и малое светило, чтобы управлять ночью. А также Он создал звёзды.
reading.question: How many great lights did God make, and what did they rule?
options: Two — a greater to rule the day and a lesser to rule the night
One, to light the whole world
Three — for morning, noon, and night
reading.correct: Two — a greater to rule the day and a lesser to rule the night
reading.explain: God made two great lights — the greater to govern the day, the lesser to govern the night — and He also made the stars.

reading.ru: Бог сказал: да наполнится вода живностью, и да полетят над землёй по небосводу птицы.
reading.question: What living things did God create on the fifth day?
reading.explain: On the fifth day God filled the waters with living creatures and made the birds that fly above the earth.

reading.ru: Бог благословил их и сказал: «Плодитесь и размножайтесь, наполняйте воды в морях, и пусть птицы множатся на земле».
reading.question: What blessing did God give the sea creatures and the birds?
reading.explain: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.”

reading.ru: Так Бог сотворил человека по образу Своему, по образу Божьему Он сотворил его.
reading.question: In whose image did God create mankind?
options: In the image of the animals
In the image of the angels
In the image of the earth
reading.explain: “So God created man in his own image; male and female he created them.”

reading.ru: Пусть он царствует над рыбами морскими и птицами небесными, над скотом и над всей землёй.
reading.question: What did God say mankind should do in relation to the other creatures?
options: Name them all in a single day
reading.explain: God gave mankind rule over the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the livestock, and all the earth.
